images.caption: Figure 1:How it works.An adversary with physical access places a pulse generator over the edge chip that runs the robot’s policy (1). A single EMFI pulse can corrupt the model, so that its safeguards are bypassed without an alarm (2), and the robot arm makes abrupt, hazardous motions next to its operator (3).Caught on camera.Three frames, 0.56 s in all: the operator reaches in, the real arm rears up and lunges at the hand. Watch the clips:https://www.youtube.com/@cat_fi_gpu.
